Problem Identification: Build a lightweight Flask app to analyze TripAdvisor hotel reviews: 1) clean text, 2) cluster into high‑level themes, 3) simple sentiment, 4) expose /predict API and a minimal UI.
Data issues / EDA: Source stored in SQLite (data/clustering.db, table tripadvisor_reviews) or CSV (data/sample_reviews_30.csv). Primary text column review_full; optional rating_review for sentiment. EDA notes: mixed casing, punctuation and emojis; duplicates possible; short/empty rows; small demo CSV. Environment constraints: missing NLTK corpora offline; limited network access for model downloads.
ML Model: Two pipelines available: (A) BERT embeddings (all‑MiniLM‑L6‑v2) + KMeans with auto‑labeled clusters; (B) Baseline TF‑IDF + KMeans for offline/demo. App auto‑selects BERT if artifacts exist, otherwise falls back to TF‑IDF or a lightweight heuristic.
Preprocess: Lowercase, remove non‑letters, tokenize, stopword removal, lemmatize. Safe fallbacks added so stopwords/wordnet absence does not block startup. Cleaned text stored transiently during training and at inference.
Issues Faced: - Server not listening → browser showed connection refused/service unavailable. - NLTK LookupError on missing corpora. - Eager BERT load at import caused slow/failing startup offline. - Port conflicts and inconsistent host binding. - Missing TF‑IDF .pkl artifacts in models/. - Minor bug during refactor (candidates variable) preventing run loop.
Resolutions: - Added /health and structured logging to server.log. - Implemented lazy BERT loading and robust NLTK fallbacks. - Added CLI flags (--host/--port) and automatic port fallback (3000→5000→8000). - Added Waitress WSGI fallback for Windows; Flask dev server otherwise. - Fixed startup bug and ensured host default 0.0.0.0 for previews. - Created TF‑IDF artifacts via src/build_tfidf_models.py and auto‑load in app. - Kept heuristic path if no models present.
How to Run: 1) Install deps: pip install -r requirements.txt. 2) Start: python app/app.py --host 0.0.0.0 --port 3000. 3) UI: http://127.0.0.1:3000/ and health: /health. 4) Train baseline models: python src/build_tfidf_models.py (creates models/kmeans_model.pkl and models/tfidf.pkl). Optional BERT: python src/train_embeddings.py --algo kmeans --clusters 5. 5) Test API: python src/ping_predict.py.]
